phase_history.notes: Concept + params derived 1:1 from reverse-engineered Fruity Peak Controller (tools/fpc/). Engine already built + validated in tools/fpc/FPCLfo.h.
Complexity 3/5. Per-sample control tick (decay /SR + period-in-samples). Output = mod-params + optional CV. Phased impl A-D.
Visage v1: two-panel FL meter-box, 9 wheels + shape select + CV toggle + meter strip. Design/v1-*.md + Source/VisageControls.h.
CMake+Processor+Editor wired to FPCEngine. Build PASSED, PluginVal PASSED. VST3 + Standalone produced. Perceptual-100 calibration constants in PluginProcessor.h.

User pivot: LFO-only tempo-synced volume tremolo (Base=volume, Depth=swing, Speed=steps 1/2..128, Phase=0/25/50/75%). Dropped peak follower + CV. Fixed non-draggable wheels via defensive ensureLayout(). Rebuild PASSED, PluginVal PASSED.

3-phase FPC LFO match. P1: out=Base+shape*Volume (bipolar log-taper sign-flip), Saw shape, full phase, Sync/Free. P2: normalised tension warp (endpoints fixed, fixes amplitude-shrink). P3: locked to decompiled FL literals (taper 6/256/0.2; tension 1001/128/0.1+warp), residual ~float-eps (8.5e-8 / 3.4e-8). Catch2 14 cases/9473 assertions + PluginVal strictness 10 PASS. Drag bug: windowPosition() fix intact; VisageJuceHost.h untouched here.

framework_selection.rationale: Button/wheel-heavy two-panel layout from the original DFM maps cleanly to pure-C++ Visage vector wheels; no HTML/JS needed. User-selected.
framework_selection.implementation_strategy: VisageControls.h custom wheels matching PEAK + LFO panels; meter/scope visualiser.
